hint: Recognition now runs on ONNX Runtime instead of Paddle Lite, and the developer is now SuperMonster003. The previous Paddle Lite implementation is published separately as Paddle OCR (PP-OCRv3 Paddle Lite) (plugin ID `paddle-ocr-pp-ocrv3-paddle-lite`, variant `v3-paddle-lite`) and can be installed alongside this plugin. Versions 1.0.6 and earlier belong to that Paddle Lite plugin, which continues in its own repository

The plugin now comes as five language packages (Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean), each a separate APK; the Simplified Chinese package keeps the original package name and plugin ID

Choosing a package by `profile` and the `useCls` option need AutoJs6 6.8.0 or later; older hosts do not choose by `profile` and do not pass `useCls` on. This plugin declares host version code 5935 (AutoJs6 6.8.0) as its minimum
feature: Support x86_64 and x86 devices, including emulators, for four ABIs in total
Add the `useCls` option, which checks the text direction before recognition so text rotated by 180 degrees can be read; it is off by default
`useOpenCL` maps to NNAPI in the ONNX Runtime edition: Android 8.1 and later use NNAPI, and older versions or devices where NNAPI is unavailable fall back to the CPU

Choose a language with `profile` (`zh`, `en`, `zh-hant`, `ja`, `ko`) and the Paddle Lite edition with `variant: "v3-paddle-lite"`; without them, the Simplified Chinese package is the default among the PP-OCRv3 plugins
improvement: `useSlim` now uses detection and recognition models quantized to int8 with ONNX Runtime dynamic quantization
dependency: Add ONNX Runtime Android 1.21.1 and remove Paddle Lite

PaddleOCR PP-OCRv3 models are now in ONNX format, converted from the official inference models, with new English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean recognition models and a text direction model

OpenCV 4.8.0 is shipped again as the shared library libopencv_java4.so, one per ABI, as in the PP-OCRv4 plugin (1.0.6 linked it statically into libNative.so). Packaged applications take this library from the OpenCV plugin, not from this plugin: packaging with this plugin adds the OpenCV plugin automatically and fails if it is not installed

hint: Packaged apps that use this version need AutoJs6 6.8.0 or later as the host; older hosts can package it only together with OpenCV
fix: Native failures during model loading or inference aborted the plugin process; they are now reported to the host as errors
improvement: libNative.so no longer exports OpenCV symbols and the APK no longer ships libopencv_java4.so, so it is smaller and packaged apps can use it alongside another OpenCV version
dependency: Remove the OpenCV Android AAR 4.8.0; only the statically linked OpenCV Android SDK 4.8.0 remains, verified by SHA-256 when downloaded

improvement: Raise compileSdk and targetSdk to 37 (Android 17); the plugin's behavior does not depend on the new target
Android App info icons share Icon Studio artwork and light/dark backgrounds while preserving transparent Plugin Center artwork and existing launcher choices
fix: SDK XML v4 parsing warnings with AGP 9.1 and APK native alignment checks incorrectly triggered by JVM unit-test assembly tasks, using shared build plugins 1.8.3
Incomplete cleanup of temporary JNI references during initialization string conversion; initialization now stops promptly on JNI exceptions _[`issue #575`](http://issues.autojs6.com/575)_
Plugin center version and ABI information matches the installed plugin APK
Encoded image input is limited to 64 MiB and supports file descriptors and pipes
Version dates use a consistent English format
improvement: Validate release APK versions, signing and the complete variant set before creating download artifacts
Images may contain at most 16777216 pixels; raw image buffers are limited to 64 MiB

fix: Paddle Lite crashed (SIGSEGV) when the first text detection of a process used a short image such as 1000 x 320; the detector is now warmed up once with a 960 x 960 blank image before the first real detection
The `clean` task failed when the Paddle OCR native dependency cleanup flag was not initialized
improvement: Synced the OpenCV 4.8.0 native library to the NDK r28c (Clang 19.0.1) rebuild (donor: AutoJs6-Plugin-OpenCV); `libopencv_java4.so` for all 4 ABIs keeps 16 KB `PT_LOAD` alignment and ships with a provenance manifest
Build verification of 16 KB page alignment for 64-bit native libraries, including manifest contract checks and JSON reports

feature: Paddle OCR (PP-OCRv3) plugin service, with plugin ID `paddle-ocr-pp-ocrv3`, engine `paddle-ocr`, and variant `v3`
Support discovering and invoking the plugin through `org.autojs.plugin.PADDLE_OCR`
Support `ocr.paddle.recognizeText(image)` text recognition and `ocr.paddle.detect(image)` text detection for screenshots, local image files, and raw ARGB_8888 image input
Bundle PaddleOCR PP-OCRv3 CPU models, running on Paddle Lite and OpenCV 4.8.0

Multilingual resources for plugin information, instructions, README, and CHANGELOG: Spanish/French/Russian/Arabic/Japanese/Korean/English/Simplified Chinese/Hong Kong Traditional Chinese/Taiwan Traditional Chinese
improvement: Support ABI APK builds, including `arm64-v8a`/`armeabi-v7a` and `universal` packages
Release APK filenames include project name, version number, and ABI variant
Standardize the README layout and Gradle platform version management
